a_BLOCK.code: SMALLM_VAR_CUDA::unit_body; expert-wide target NT1*nblk[e], two fence/barrier/atomic publication sites
a_BLOCK.implementation: Index all publications/acquires by e*4+nb, target NT1;128 done counters plus3 existing control slots;512B done region. Same store/fence/publish/acquire order. Dispatch only M16/M32.

b_CANCEL.code: SMALLM_VAR_CUDA::W2 epilogue v*=256*gs2[e], then z=v*(1+pnw), ss+=z*z, final RMSNorm epsilon1e-8
b_CANCEL.identity: a*u/sqrt(a*a*mean(u*u)+eps) = sign(a)*u/sqrt(mean(u*u)+eps/(a*a)); a=0 produceszero. W13 is untouched because SwiGLU intervenes.
b_CANCEL.implementation: Remove W2 element multiply; prepare96 FP32 norm-metadata values, retaining original32 FP32 global scales. Finalizer uses eps/a^2 and sign; double evaluation for epsilon overflow/underflow cases; zero scale/zero norm guarded.
b_CANCEL.extreme_tests: extreme_validation.json:160 helper cases, including signed/tiny/huge scales;component_validation.json:zero/negative and1e-10/1e10 full native MoE cases

c_SHARDS.code: H200-gated PAIR flush_vec_norm uses a single atomic ss+off+n; LOCAL exports one CTA partial per pair and adds finalizer gather
c_SHARDS.implementation: Only replace PAIR norm slot by2/4/8 c-indexed shards. Each W13 tile0 zeroes all shards before publication; finalizer sums shards. No CTA-local export/gather.

d_TWO_BASE.code: S15 uses recoded dq8 sign/magnitude bit extraction plus128 HMUL2 per math tile; the finite scalar identity S/1.5S is exact
d_TWO_BASE.precondition: audit_decode.py:8,128 finite signed-format packed-half checks. Same16 output BF16x2 registers per lane in old/new probes.
d_TWO_BASE.decision: Dropped before H200: sm90a integer instructions37->406 and registers30->31 for this implementation.
d_TWO_BASE.leaves_open: A more efficient packed exponent decoder; this loss does not close all two-base methods.

e_PACK5.code: S15 tile has32,768 packed-code bytes plus4,096 exact recoded scale bytes; prefix tables retain FP4 and scale precision
e_PACK5.measurement: Official complete layer weight tensors from generate_weights(seed5353):100,663,296 scale bytes;every256-byte packet fits a32-symbol window. Final32B tile header and8B offset accounting:4.05816% byte cut.
e_PACK5.implementation: 256-scale packets:one base byte,5-bit deltas or raw256 bytes. Per-tile raw mask,aligned payload and64-bit tile offsets;timed TMA/decode. Wide raw transfer and full-bank code/scale equality verified.
e_PACK5.leaves_open: Actual H200 benefit after decoding and metadata cost; packet widths and layouts can differ.
